* 1 tsp. ground cumin
* 1 tsp. dried mint
* 1 tsp. red pepper flakes (optional)
* 1 cup water
* 1 tsp. vegetable oil
* 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
* 1 egg, beaten
* 1 cup sour cream (optional)

Instructions:

6. Fold the edges of the dough up and over the filling, pinching the edges to seal.
7. Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
8. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the kubdari and cook until golden brown on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
9. Serve hot with sour cream, if desired.
